_comment: Substitution parameters for benches/ldbc_benchmark.rs at SF1.
PREFER --derive-params. A hand-maintained file like this one is right for
exactly one extract: LDBC ids are assigned per `datagen` run and are not
portable. The values below match the extract scripts/download_ldbc_snb.sh
fetches and returned 0 rows for 17 of 21 reads against a different SF1
samples every parameter from the dataset in front of you at the stated
percentile and prints what it sampled, which is what makes a run
comparable with another engine's. Add --write-params <path> to keep the
result; ldbc-sf1-params.p50.json is one such file.
This file is kept as a template for the shape --params-file reads.
